lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs₂MgCd crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms—8 Cs, 4 Mg, and 4 Cd—distributed across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd and Mg each adopt tetrahedral coordination by four Cs neighbors, while each Cs center has four geometric neighbors (2 Cd, 2 Mg) at 3.56 Å. The connectivity forms a three-dimensional periodic network, with corner-sharing tetrahedra observed between Cd–Cd, Cd–Mg, Mg–Mg, and Cs–Cs polyhedra.
